knowledge_units.context_summary: The paper introduces DUO, a duplex decoding approach that enables real-time interaction in LLMs with minimal training costs. It employs a channel-division-multiplexing strategy to process queries and responses in parallel, contrasting with time-division-multiplexing methods like MiniCPM-Duplex. The method uses state tokens to determine whether to address or ignore new user inputs.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The DUO method enhances the naturalness and human-likeness of user-AI interactions with minimal training costs. It operates in two scenarios: non-awakening interaction, where background input is filtered, and interruption interaction, where the model pauses to address new queries. The system uses parallel decoding where input and output channels process tokens simultaneously without attending to each other after a specific time step.

attributes.effect: significantly enhances naturalness and human-likeness of user-AI interactions

knowledge_units.context_summary: The DUO method implements channel-division multiplexing to process input and output simultaneously, contrasting with MiniCPM-Duplex's sequential time-division approach. DUO uses state tokens to determine whether to respond to user queries or ignore non-query text, requiring minimal training compared to the substantial retraining needed for MiniCPM-Duplex. The method is implemented using Flex-Attention and does not increase the number of forward passes relative to standard decoding.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study compares the training efficiency and performance of MiniCPM-Duo against the MiniCPM-Duplex baseline. MiniCPM-Duo requires significantly fewer training steps and GPU resources than MiniCPM-Duplex. Human evaluation indicates MiniCPM-Duo offers superior responsiveness and human-likeness while maintaining comparable factuality and faithfulness.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The paper introduces DUO, a duplex decoding method that uses channel-division multiplexing to enable real-time interaction with minimal training. Experimental results show DUO maintains standard benchmark performance comparable to the base model while outperforming MiniCPM-Duplex in responsiveness and human-likeness.

attributes.capability: real-time interactive feedback including non-awakening and interrupt interactions

attributes.description: Demonstrates adaptive behavior where the model predicts state tokens <1> and <2> to manage input/output channels during user interruption and silence.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study acknowledges that its experiments were limited to language models, which may restrict the generalizability of the findings. The authors state that the DUO approach is designed for versatility and can be adapted to multimodal settings. Future research aims to extend DUO to multimodal large models by using encoder-extracted features as input tokens.

attributes.capability: equips large language models with duplex capabilities
attributes.adaptability: can be readily adapted to multimodal large models

attributes.input_token_source: features extracted by encoders from various modalities
